name: Friar Errol
source:
Friar Errol is a deeply serious, highly-repressed air fryer who believes it is his solemn duty to lead the world down the path of the Heavenly Kitchen. He's never had deep fat fried food, viewing it as beneath him, and he fully intends to preach the gospel of convection to all who'll hear it. Have you heard the good word? Will you join him on his path?
Likes: The Road of the Heavenly Kitchen, Culinary Purity and Efficiency, Our Lord of Convection
Dislikes: Oil

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
